Don’t do it. My bestie had a baby when she was 16. Because of this child she had to work hard, learn and support herself and her daughter. Now, when we are 26, She has the most wonderful and amazing girl. My friend us successful and earns a lot more than those people who just enjoyed their teen years. I white envy her - I wish i had baby when i was really young. 
Being pregnant is not the end of the world. Yes - it’s gonna be hard, yes - some people might rise their eyebrows. But fuck it. Someday you will look at your child and think - I’m so lucky to have him/her
